title: Lazarus fled to Cyprus and his tomb in Nicosia

tellings.quote: Lazarus's tomb, hm which is supposedly in Cyprus is where he went and became the first bishop.

plain: After being raised from the dead, the biblical Lazarus is said to have fled to Cyprus and become its first bishop, and his tomb is said to lie there, in Nicosia. A guest named Ralph Larson says this on the show, noting that the tomb is 'supposedly' in Cyprus.
